insight: Built by UX agency Adam Fard Studio; the company says it is trusted by over 1M users.
name: UX Pilot
tagline: Superfast UX/UI design with AI — wireframes and high-fidelity screens from a prompt.
description: UX Pilot is an AI UX/UI design tool that generates wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and full user flows from text prompts, letting product teams ideate, design, and hand off web and mobile apps in one place. It can wireframe using a team's own design system — feed it a component library once and it reuses those components, spacing, and color tokens — and offers a companion Figma plugin. It targets designers, product teams, and founders who need quality designs quickly.
edge: Feed it your component library once and it wireframes in your exact design system — components, spacing, and color tokens — not generic mockups.
pros: Free tier with starter credits, no card
Full user flows from a text prompt
cons: Polished output still needs designer review
